thread:
anika: Quick follow-up from the PM: we saw recurring patterns around streaming reliability — token timeouts on long gens, truncated/partial output, and fragile reconnect behavior under load. Need owners and short runbook items.

pete: I can own reconnect behavior. Short plan: make resumes idempotent, widen jittered backoff, surface fast-fail reason codes. Target Wed EOD.

aj: I'll own partial-output detection and telemetry. Plan: emit `stream.eos_received`, `stream.partial=true/false`, `final_chunk_delay_ms`, and add a Datadog panel. ETA Tue afternoon.

maria: I'll coordinate canary tests for mobile and web SDKs, plus a network-throttle matrix for US/EU/APAC. Will validate client resume and `Retry-After` honor. ETA Thu.

sam: I'll take timeouts. Current 30s per-token may be too tight for long-gen models. Proposal: add per-route `token_timeout_ms` with default 30s, + override 90s for `/v1/streams/long-gen`. Gate behind feature flag for 2 weeks. ETA Mon/PR.

anika: Good. Let's capture explicit action items (owner, what, due). Also we decided: prefer client-driven resume (client supplies last-good-index) over server buffered replays; if a stream reconnects >3x in 5m, page `#eng-oncall`.

pete: Draft runtime config I'll put in the PR:
```
reconnect: {
  max_retries: 5,
  base_backoff_ms: 200,
  max_backoff_ms: 5000,
  jitter: full,
  resume_id_header: X-Stream-Resume-Id
}
```

aj: For metrics I'll add `partial_chunk_rate` and `avg_final_chunk_delay_ms`. Alert: `partial_chunk_rate > 0.5% for 10m` -> page.

maria: Mobile SDKs often retry aggressively. I'll add `sdk.defer_reconnect=true` flag and ensure clients respect server `Retry-After`.

sam: Implementation note: expose route-level config `token_timeout_ms` and a feature flag `ff.streaming.token_timeout_override`. Will prototype in dev today.

anika: Ops checklist for rollout:
- runtime reconnect config (pete)
- metrics & dashboard (aj)
- feature-flag deploy for token timeout (sam)
- mobile+web canary (maria)
- 24h smoke traffic then promote (ops)

pete: I'll also add a unit/integration test that fuzz-disconnects sockets and asserts idempotent resume semantics. Will push draft PR.

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled job `streaming/reconnect-config-2318` created, run id run-8122

maria: Support request: can support list customer incidents with partial responses in the last 90d? @support

support: Posted list in support tracker (ref: SUP-4521) with customer timestamps and routes.

anika: I'll add a weekly 15-min "streaming signal review" for 6 weeks; if >2 regressions surface we'll escalate to an emergency sprint.

aj: Dashboard link will be posted when ready: <https://dashboards.internal/d/s/streaming-partial-chunk>

sam: also recording the long-sequence harness config in PR so we can replay failing cases.

pete: ack. Will include repro harness pointers in my PR and the test.

ops-bot: incidentbot: reminder set for 2023-11-12 09:00 UTC — "streaming reliability follow-up sync"

anika: Thanks all. I'll file these into the postmortem action tracker and assign owners. Ping me if ETAs change. :white_check_mark:
